_about: Who must clear the waste, checked in order; the first rule that matches wins. near_railway_m uses seed/land_railway.geojson; in_national_highways uses seed/land_national_highways.geojson. Land type names must match the Defra list exactly.

rules.note: Within 20 m of railway land. Network Rail must clear it.
National Highways land. National Highways must clear it. The council can still prosecute.
Railway land. Network Rail must clear it.
Private land. The council may clear it and bill the landowner under s.59(7), unless the occupier allowed the dumping.

rules.law: EPA 1990 s.89(1)(a) duty to keep land and highways clear
rules.note: Back alley. The council clears dumping here, including on privately owned alleys.

default.law: EPA 1990 s.89(1)(a) duty to keep land and highways clear
default.note: Public land or highway. The council must clear it.
